clips.title: The story
paras: Madame Eva sends Ghost Hair Comb to Blind Mary at her lonely home on Duskwood’s outskirts. The comb stirs grief, then yields ghostly hair for Eva to spin into thread.

Madame Eva of Darkshire sends Ghost Hair Comb to Blind Mary, who lives in a lonely, dilapidated dwelling on Duskwood’s outskirts. At the sight of it, the ghost recoils in horror. She must face that she is no longer the lovely living woman she remembers. Grief-stricken, Mary thrusts the comb away, leaving strands of her ghostly hair tangled in its teeth.
